expression: (async () => { const q=indexedDB.open("populous-new-dawn",1); const db=await new Promise((r,j)=>{q.onsuccess=()=>r(q.result);q.onerror=()=>j(q.error)}); try { const tx=db.transaction("checkpoints","readonly"),req=tx.objectStore("checkpoints").get("profile"); const profile=await new Promise((r,j)=>{req.onsuccess=()=>r(req.result);req.onerror=()=>j(req.error)}); const s=window.testSceneRef.current,w=s.world; return {at:new Date().toISOString(),profile,level:w.outcome.level,turn:w.turn,status:w.status,outcome:structuredClone(w.outcome),greenFollowers:w.units.filter(u=>u.team==="green"&&u.hp>0).length,greenBuildings:w.buildings.filter(b=>b.team==="green"&&b.hp>0).length,body:document.body.innerText};} finally {db.close()} })()
